s0401.literal: Ninth month, on xinmao day, at Yijing, Lin, Weiyuan, Posa, and other places in Eastern Capital torrential rains fell; the river overflowed and inundated farmland;
s0401.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao day, torrential rains at Yijing, Lin, Weiyuan, Posa, and other places in Eastern Capital made the river overflow and inundate farmland;

s0402.literal: At Dading, Jinyuan, Gaozhou, Wuping, Xingzhong, and other places frost and hail damaged crops.
s0402.idiomatic: At Dading, Jinyuan, Gaozhou, Wuping, Xingzhong, and other places frost and hail damaged crops.

s0403.literal: On dingyou day Mars transgressed Changyuan.
s0403.idiomatic: On dingyou day Mars transgressed Changyuan.

s0404.literal: On jihai day Hunan-Guangxi branch secretariat officials said: "Hainan Qiongzhou Route pacification commissioner Chen Zhongda, Nanning Army zongguan Xie Youkui, and Yanlan zongguan Fu Picheng, with their private ships numbering one hundred twenty and Li troops numbering more than one thousand seven hundred, assisted the campaign against Jiaozhi.
s0404.idiomatic: On jihai day Hunan-Guangxi branch secretariat officials said, "Hainan Qiongzhou Route pacification commissioner Chen Zhongda, Nanning Army zongguan Xie Youkui, and Yanlan zongguan Fu Picheng, with 120 private ships and more than 1,700 Li troops, had assisted the campaign against Jiaozhi.

s0405.literal: " An edict ordered Chen Zhongda remain pacification commissioner with tiger tally; Youkui and Picheng also remain coastal military zongguan with gold tallies.
s0405.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Chen Zhongda remain pacification commissioner with a tiger tally; Youkui and Picheng also remain coastal military zongguan with gold tallies.

s0406.literal: On gengzi day Venus transgressed Tianjiang.
s0406.idiomatic: On gengzi day Venus transgressed Tianjiang.

s0407.literal: Paper currency of eleven thousand one hundred ingots was granted to the impoverished under Prince Baba's following.
s0407.idiomatic: 11,100 ingots of paper currency were granted to the impoverished under Prince Baba's following.

s0409.literal: Because the Western Capital and Pingluan Route suffered famine, wine was forbidden.
s0409.idiomatic: Because the Western Capital and Pingluan Route suffered famine, wine was forbidden.

s0410.literal: On yisi day the moon transgressed Bi.
s0410.idiomatic: On yisi day the moon transgressed Bi.

s0411.literal: Twenty thousand shi of rice and ten thousand sheep were granted to the Tangut army under Asha.
s0411.idiomatic: 20,000 shi of rice and 10,000 sheep were granted to the Tangut army under Asha.

s0412.literal: On dingwei day the Kingdom of Annam dispatched its Central Grandee Ruan Wenyan and Attendant Grandee Li Zhongqian to present local products.
s0412.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Kingdom of Annam dispatched Central Grandee Ruan Wenyan and Attendant Grandee Li Zhongqian to present local products.

s0413.literal: On wushen day Xiancheng, Yizhou, and Northern Capital, because of Nayan's rebellion the people had abandoned farming and frost and hail had also struck, reported famine; an edict ordered fifty thousand shi of sea-transport grain to relieve them.
s0413.idiomatic: On wushen day Xiancheng, Yizhou, and Northern Capital, where Nayan's rebellion had left the people unable to farm and frost and hail had also struck, reported famine; an edict ordered 50,000 shi of sea-transport grain to relieve them.

s0414.literal: On xinhai day Mars transgressed the Taiwei Western Rampart Senior General.
s0414.idiomatic: On xinhai day Mars transgressed the Taiwei Western Rampart Senior General.

s0415.literal: On renzi day Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper.
s0415.idiomatic: On renzi day Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper.

s0416.literal: Obstruction of the Jiangnan tea tax was forbidden.
s0416.idiomatic: Obstruction of the Jiangnan tea tax was forbidden.

s0417.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo came to court.
s0417.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo came to court.

s0418.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the wuwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0418.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the wuwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0419.literal: On renxu day the moon transgressed the great star of Niulang.
s0419.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon transgressed the great star of Niulang.

s0420.literal: On jiazi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0420.idiomatic: On jiazi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0421.literal: Sangge requested grants of paper currency to Ye Li, Ma Shao, Buqumu, Gao Zhu, and others; an edict granted Li one hundred fifty ingots, and Buqumu, Shao, and Zhu each one hundred ingots.
s0421.idiomatic: Sangge requested paper currency grants for Ye Li, Ma Shao, Buqumu, Gao Zhu, and others; an edict granted Li 150 ingots and Buqumu, Shao, and Zhu 100 ingots each.

s0422.literal: He also said: "The Central Secretariat formerly stood before the Inner Palace; Ahmad moved it north; please restore it to its original site.
s0422.idiomatic: He also said, "The Central Secretariat formerly stood before the Inner Palace; Ahmad moved it north; please restore it to its original site.

s0424.literal: On guiyou day Jiangxi branch secretariat Yuedeshi said: "Guangdong is poor, remote, and dangerously distant — a haunt where bandits of Jiangxi and Fujian appear and vanish; I ask that ten thousand troops be divided from the Jiangnan provinces to reinforce my command.
s0424.idiomatic: On guiyou day Jiangxi branch secretariat Yuedeshi said, "Guangdong is poor, remote, and dangerously distant — a haunt where Jiangxi and Fujian bandits appear and vanish; I ask that 10,000 troops be divided from the Jiangnan provinces to reinforce my command.

s0425.literal: " An edict ordered Jiangxi's Hudutemur to give him five thousand troops.
s0425.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Jiangxi's Hudutemur to give him 5,000 troops.

s0426.literal: On bingzi day Guo You and Yang Jukuan were executed.
s0426.idiomatic: On bingzi day Guo You and Yang Jukuan were executed.

s0427.literal: On wuyin day Sangge said: "The Prince of Beian's chancellor's office has no seal, yet the Prince of Anxi's chancellor alone has a seal — this is truly not precedent; please take it back.
s0427.idiomatic: On wuyin day Sangge said, "The Prince of Beian's chancellor's office has no seal, yet the Prince of Anxi's chancellor alone has a seal — this is truly not precedent; please take it back.

s0428.literal: Prince Shengnahor's seal inscription reads 'Precious seal of the imperial nephew and honored clansman' — such a seal is not what a subject should use; according to his allotment it should be changed to 'Seal of the Prince of Jinan.'
s0428.idiomatic: Prince Shengnahor's seal inscription reads 'Precious seal of the imperial nephew and honored clansman' — such a seal is not what a subject should use; according to his allotment it should be changed to 'Seal of the Prince of Jinan.'

s0430.literal: Following commander-in-chief Wang Weihe's request, five thousand troops from his garrison in Sichuan were divided off to garrison-farm at Liupan.
s0430.idiomatic: At commander-in-chief Wang Weihe's request, 5,000 troops from his Sichuan garrison were divided off to garrison-farm at Liupan.

s0431.literal: On yiyou day Mars transgressed Left Law.
s0431.idiomatic: On yiyou day Mars transgressed Left Law.

s0432.literal: The Shaanxi Precious Notes Intendancy was established.
s0432.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Precious Notes Intendancy was established.

s0433.literal: The native officials Huozhe and Ahe of Luobei dian and the son of Weimo Helasun all submitted.
s0433.idiomatic: The native officials Huozhe and Ahe of Luobei dian and the son of Weimo Helasun all submitted.

s0434.literal: On bingxu day Fan Wenhu said: "At Hao, Yi, Eastern Capital, and other places the people's hearts are still unsettled; a branch secretariat should be established to pacify and reassure them.
s0434.idiomatic: On bingxu day Fan Wenhu said, "At Hao, Yi, Eastern Capital, and other places the people's hearts are still unsettled; a branch secretariat should be established to pacify and reassure them.

s0435.literal: " An edict established the Liaoyang Route Branch Secretariat; Xieshgan and Shelitemur were both made branch secretariat grand councillors, Hong Chachiu right vice councillor, Yiersahe left vice councillor, Yang Renfeng and Alaowading both associate administrators.
s0435.idiomatic: " An edict established the Liaoyang Route branch secretariat; Xieshgan and Shelitemur were both made branch secretariat grand councillors, Hong Chachiu right vice councillor, Yiersahe left vice councillor, and Yang Renfeng and Alaowading associate administrators.

s0436.literal: Eleventh month, on renchen day Venus transgressed Leibi Formation; the moon had a corona around Venus and Saturn.
s0436.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renchen day Venus transgressed Leibi Formation, and the moon had a corona around Venus and Saturn.

s0437.literal: Yunnan branch secretariat right vice councillor Ailu's army halted at Muwumen in Jiaozhi; the Prince of Zhaowen defended it with forty thousand men; Ailu defeated them and captured generals Li Shi and He Ying.
s0437.idiomatic: Yunnan branch secretariat right vice councillor Ailu's army halted at Muwumen in Jiaozhi; the Prince of Zhaowen defended it with 40,000 men; Ailu defeated them and captured generals Li Shi and He Ying.

s0438.literal: The ban on river fishing at Taiyuan and Baode was lifted.
s0438.idiomatic: The ban on river fishing at Taiyuan and Baode was lifted.

s0439.literal: Sangge was made Grand Master of the Golden Gate and Purple Radiance, right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and concurrently controller of the Directorate and director of the Bureau of Meritorious Achievements.
s0439.idiomatic: Sangge was made Grand Master of the Golden Gate and Purple Radiance, right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and concurrently controller of the directorate and director of the bureau of meritorious achievements.

s0440.literal: At Sangge's request, Pingzhang Tiemur replaced his post; right vice councillor Alaghunsari was promoted to grand councillor; Ye Li was promoted to right vice councillor; associate administrator Ma Shao was promoted to left vice councillor.
s0440.idiomatic: At Sangge's request, Pingzhang Tiemur replaced his post; right vice councillor Alaghunsari was promoted to grand councillor; Ye Li was promoted to right vice councillor; and associate administrator Ma Shao was promoted to left vice councillor.

s0441.literal: The Academy of Scholarly Worthies was promoted to rank two正.
s0441.idiomatic: The Academy of Scholarly Worthies was promoted to rank two正.

s0442.literal: On bingshen day Mars transgressed the Taiwei Eastern Rampart Senior Minister.
s0442.idiomatic: On bingshen day Mars transgressed the Taiwei Eastern Rampart Senior Minister.

s0443.literal: On dingyou day Sangge said: "Previously Prince Manggalai was enfeoffed as Prince of Anxi, governing Hexi, Tibet, Sichuan, and other places, and a princely chancellor's office was established; later he was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin and held two gold seals.
s0443.idiomatic: On dingyou day Sangge said, "Previously Prince Manggalai was enfeoffed as Prince of Anxi, governing Hexi, Tibet, Sichuan, and other places, and a princely chancellor's office was established; later he was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin and held two gold seals.

s0444.literal: Now the successor Anandapati still inherits the Prince of Anxi seal, while his younger brother Antanbuhua separately uses the Prince of Qin seal; below them the tutor's seal is again employed in administration — one fief with two princes — this is likely improper in regulation.
s0444.idiomatic: Now the successor Anandapati still inherits the Prince of Anxi seal, while his younger brother Antanbuhua separately uses the Prince of Qin seal; below them the tutor's seal is again employed in administration — one fief with two princes — likely improper in regulation.

s0445.literal: " An edict ordered Anandapati succeed as Prince of Anxi with the princely tutor still appointed, the Prince of Qin seal submitted, and the princely tutor post held by Antanbuhua abolished.
s0445.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Anandapati succeed as Prince of Anxi with the princely tutor still appointed, the Prince of Qin seal submitted, and the princely tutor post held by Antanbuhua abolished.

s0446.literal: On wuxu day five hundred Han troops of Biebashibali and newly submitted troops were sent to garrison-farm at Hemiyusuqu.
s0446.idiomatic: On wuxu day 500 Han troops of Biebashibali and newly submitted troops were sent to garrison-farm at Hemiyusuqu.

s0447.literal: On jihai day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Siming; Cheng Pengfei and Aoluchi and others advanced separately with the Prince of Zhennan; Abachi led ten thousand as vanguard.
s0447.idiomatic: On jihai day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Siming; Cheng Pengfei, Aoluchi, and others advanced separately with the Prince of Zhennan; Abachi led 10,000 as vanguard.

s0448.literal: On gengzi day Venus was visible by day.
s0448.idiomatic: On gengzi day Venus was visible by day.

s0449.literal: Dadu Route suffered flooding; this year's field rent of one hundred twenty-nine thousand one hundred eighty shi was remitted.
s0449.idiomatic: Dadu Route suffered flooding; this year's field rent of 129,180 shi was remitted.

s0450.literal: On xinchou day Umar, Fan Ji, and Cheng Pengfei and others then pressed toward Jiaozhi, succeeding everywhere they went.
s0450.idiomatic: On xinchou day Umar, Fan Ji, and Cheng Pengfei and others then pressed toward Jiaozhi, succeeding everywhere they went.

s0451.literal: The Court of the Imperial Stud was changed to the Grand Stud Court, rank three, still subordinate to the Palace Provisioner; Yuechi'er and Tutuhe were placed in charge.
s0451.idiomatic: The Court of the Imperial Stud was changed to the Grand Stud Court, rank three, still subordinate to the palace provisioner; Yuechi'er and Tutuhe were placed in charge.

s0452.literal: On bingwu day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Jiehe; Jiaozhi dispatched troops to resist and defend; the vanguard broke them all.
s0452.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Jiehe; Jiaozhi dispatched troops to resist; the vanguard broke them all.

s0453.literal: On jiyou day an edict ordered deliberation on suppressing banditry.
s0453.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict ordered deliberation on suppressing banditry.

s0454.literal: Sangge and Yusutemur said: "Jiangnan has been under allegiance ten years, yet bandits to this day have not been pacified; an edict should set a time limit for recruitment and capture, and settling the people should be the responsibility of prefecture and county officials — those who fail should be dismissed.
s0454.idiomatic: Sangge and Yusutemur said, "Jiangnan has been under allegiance ten years, yet bandits to this day have not been pacified; an edict should set a time limit for recruitment and capture, and settling the people should be the responsibility of prefecture and county officials — those who fail should be dismissed.

s0455.literal: " Ye Li said: "I was in Zhangzhou ten years and know the matter in detail; generally military officers who crave profit and collude with bandits are especially hard to suppress.
s0455.idiomatic: " Ye Li said, "I was in Zhangzhou ten years and know the matter in detail; generally military officers who crave profit and collude with bandits are especially hard to suppress.

s0456.literal: Each garrison commander should by regulation rotate every three years — then this abuse may be reformed.
s0456.idiomatic: Each garrison commander should by regulation rotate every three years — then this abuse may be reformed.

s0457.literal: " The Emperor approved all their proposals, and an edict carried them out.
s0457.idiomatic: " The Emperor approved all their proposals, and an edict carried them out.

s0458.literal: The imperial son-in-law Tiemur was enfeoffed as Prince of Jining Commandery.
s0458.idiomatic: The imperial son-in-law Tiemur was enfeoffed as Prince of Jining Commandery.

s0459.literal: On renzi day Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Hudutemur was ordered to supervise capture of bandits in Guangdong and other places.
s0459.idiomatic: On renzi day Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Hudutemur was ordered to supervise capture of bandits in Guangdong and other places.

s0460.literal: On jiayin day the Dadu metropolitan and Jining grain transport commissions were ordered to divide grain transport duties between them.
s0460.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Dadu metropolitan and Jining grain transport commissions were ordered to divide grain transport duties between them.

s0461.literal: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Wanjie; all armies assembled.
s0461.idiomatic: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Wanjie; all armies assembled.

s0462.literal: The chief bandit of Fujian, Zhang Zhijian, was captured; his partisans were all pacified.
s0462.idiomatic: The chief bandit of Fujian, Zhang Zhijian, was captured; his partisans were all pacified.

s0463.literal: The four Jiangnan provinces were instructed to recruit and capture bandits.
s0463.idiomatic: The four Jiangnan provinces were instructed to recruit and capture bandits.

s0464.literal: On bingchen day Mars transgressed Jinxian.
s0464.idiomatic: On bingchen day Mars transgressed Jinxian.

s0465.literal: Twelfth month, on guihai day, the Court of the Imperial Carriage was established.
s0465.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guihai day, the Court of the Imperial Carriage was established.

s0466.literal: Shunyuan pacification commissioner Tuluguyan and Jinzhu Stockade chief Saolü and others submitted with the one hundred twenty-five stockades under their command.
s0466.idiomatic: Shunyuan pacification commissioner Tuluguyan and Jinzhu Stockade chief Saolü and others submitted with the 125 stockades under their command.

s0467.literal: On jiazi day a princely tutor was appointed for the imperial prince, the Prince of Beian; all military supplies and original-rank affairs were to be administered by the princely tutor.
s0467.idiomatic: On jiazi day a princely tutor was appointed for the imperial prince, the Prince of Beian; all military supplies and original-rank affairs were to be administered by the princely tutor.

s0468.literal: On bingyin day the moon transgressed Bi, and Venus was visible by day.
s0468.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon transgressed Bi, and Venus was visible by day.

s0469.literal: On dingmao day Yangzhou province's annual rice quota was reduced by one hundred fifty thousand shi; five hundred thousand salt certificates were used to exchange for grain.
s0469.idiomatic: On dingmao day Yangzhou province's annual rice quota was reduced by 150,000 shi; 500,000 salt certificates were used to exchange for grain.

s0470.literal: The Zhexi fish tax of three thousand ingots was remitted, and the people were permitted to fish on their own.
s0470.idiomatic: The Zhexi fish tax of 3,000 ingots was remitted, and the people were permitted to fish on their own.

s0471.literal: One thousand wealthy households from Hexi, Gansu, and other places were dispatched to Chayan territory to live mixed with Han and newly submitted troops and cultivate.
s0471.idiomatic: 1,000 wealthy households from Hexi, Gansu, and other places were dispatched to Chayan territory to live mixed with Han and newly submitted troops and cultivate.

s0472.literal: At Prince of Anxi Anandapati's request, a directorate general of original-rank artisans was established.
s0472.idiomatic: At Prince of Anxi Anandapati's request, a directorate general of original-rank artisans was established.

s0473.literal: Officials of the Myriad Treasury were promoted to rank four.
s0473.idiomatic: Officials of the Myriad Treasury were promoted to rank four.

s0474.literal: On guiyou day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Maoluo Harbor, attacked Fushan Stockade, and captured it.
s0474.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Prince of Zhennan halted at Maoluo Harbor, attacked Fushan Stockade, and captured it.

s0475.literal: At the places where Princes Xiechedu and others were stationed, soil rained for seven days and nights; sheep and livestock died beyond counting; paper currency together with silks, cotton cloth, and miscellaneous goods were granted as compensation, totaling ten thousand four hundred sixty-seven ingots of paper currency in value.
s0475.idiomatic: At the places where Princes Xiechedu and others were stationed, soil rained for seven days and nights; sheep and livestock died beyond counting; paper currency together with silks, cotton cloth, and miscellaneous goods were granted as compensation, totaling 10,467 ingots of paper currency in value.

s0476.literal: On dingchou day Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan, for meritorious service in sea-route grain transport, were remotely appointed pacification commissioners.
s0476.idiomatic: On dingchou day Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan, for meritorious service in sea-route grain transport, were remotely appointed pacification commissioners.

s0477.literal: On yiyou day the Prince of Zhennan led the armies across the Fu River, halted below the Jiaozhi city, defeated its garrison troops; Ri Xuan and his son abandoned the city and fled to Gannan Fort.
s0477.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Prince of Zhennan led the armies across the Fu River, halted below the Jiaozhi city, and defeated its garrison troops; Ri Xuan and his son abandoned the city and fled to Gannan Fort.

s0478.literal: That year, Tibetan monks including Jianzang Wanbubusi were ordered to conduct Buddhist rites in seated meditation at the Great Hall, Sleeping Hall, Wanshou Mountain, Wutai Mountain, and other temples — thirty-three assemblies in all.
s0478.idiomatic: That year Tibetan monks including Jianzang Wanbubusi were ordered to conduct Buddhist rites in seated meditation at the Great Hall, Sleeping Hall, Wanshou Mountain, Wutai Mountain, and other temples — 33 assemblies in all.

s0479.literal: Capital sentences throughout the realm numbered one hundred twenty-one persons.
s0479.idiomatic: 121 persons were sentenced to death throughout the realm.

s0480.literal: The Zhexi routes suffered floods; two-tenths of this year's field rent was remitted;
s0480.idiomatic: The Zhexi routes suffered floods; two-tenths of this year's field rent was remitted;

s0481.literal: The Western Capital, Northern Capital, Longxing, Pingluan, Nanyang, Huaimeng, and other routes suffered wind and hail damaging crops;
s0481.idiomatic: The Western Capital, Northern Capital, Longxing, Pingluan, Nanyang, Huaimeng, and other routes suffered wind and hail damaging crops;

s0482.literal: Baoding, Taiyuan, Hejian, Panyang, Shunde, Nanjing, Zhending, Henan, and other routes suffered torrential rains damaging crops; Taiyuan was especially severe, with many killed as houses collapsed;
s0482.idiomatic: Baoding, Taiyuan, Hejian, Panyang, Shunde, Nanjing, Zhending, Henan, and other routes suffered torrential rains damaging crops; Taiyuan was especially severe, with many killed as houses collapsed;

s0483.literal: Pingyang suffered spring drought; the second crop withered and died; autumn seed did not enter the soil;
s0483.idiomatic: Pingyang suffered spring drought; the second crop withered and died; autumn seed did not enter the soil;

s0484.literal: Gongchang suffered hail; locust larvae became a disaster.
s0484.idiomatic: Gongchang suffered hail; locust larvae became a disaster.

s0485.literal: Sheep, horses, and paper currency were distributed in shares to imperial princes, princes, imperial sons-in-law, keshik retainers, and others, totaling more than two hundred fifty-three thousand five hundred ingots; military men among princes and keshik retainers were also granted twelve thousand two hundred horses, twenty-two thousand six hundred sheep, and more than one hundred camels.
s0485.idiomatic: Sheep, horses, and paper currency were distributed in shares to imperial princes, princes, imperial sons-in-law, keshik retainers, and others, totaling more than 253,500 ingots; military men among princes and keshik retainers also received 12,200 horses, 22,600 sheep, and more than 100 camels.

s0486.literal: Paper currency of forty-eight thousand two hundred fifty ingots was granted to relieve the impoverished including Qalaghuqa and others.
s0486.idiomatic: 48,250 ingots of paper currency were granted to relieve the impoverished including Qalaghuqa and others.
